title: Bixinta oo beddeshay Qaddarka
intro: Maalmihii ugu horreeyay ee aadanaha, nafta waxay bixin jirtay hadiyad ujeedo saafi ah leh. Haddana, xaasidnimadu waxay ku dhuuman jirtay hooska aqbalaadda. Soo hel sheekada qofkan oo cibaadadiisa iyo dhammaadkiisa naxdinta leh ay ku nool yihiin muujinta rabbaaniga ah.
clues: Waxaan ka mid ahaa jiilkii ugu horreeyay ee aadanaha.
Waxaan u soo bandhigay Rabbigeyga qurbaan, waana la ii soo dhaweeyay.
Baxnaaninta walaalkay waa la diiday, xaasidnimaduna qalbigiisa ayay madoobaatay.
Waxaan ku idhi, 'Haddii aad gacantaada ii soo fidiso si aad ii disho, gacantayda kuma fidin doono si aan kuu dilo; runtii waxaan ka baqayaa Alle, Rabbiga Caalamka.'
Waxaan noqday dhibbanaha falkii ugu horreeyay ee dil ah oo dhulka ka dhaca.
Dhiiggaygu wuu qayliyey, aniguna waxaan ahaa shahiidkii ugu horreeyay ee aan waxba galabsan.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
